english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doubting whether something is true or intended.
Use this when questioning something means doubting whether it is true or reliable.

examples.english: I doubt whether he is really ill.
examples.traditional: 我懷疑佢係咪真係病咗。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 beng6 zo2

examples.english: I began to query whether what he said was true.
examples.traditional: 我開始懷疑佢講嘅係咪真。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 ci2 waai4 ji4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 mai6 zan1
